surface.title: AI Summary
surface.sendHint: Only Generate sends this text to the provider and model shown above. Editing does not send a request.
surface.outputHint: Summary language follows the source. The point limit is a preference; review the result before using it. Model limits and remaining quota are not verified here.
input.placeholder: Type or paste text, then choose a provider and model and click Generate.
output.placeholder: The summary will appear here after you click Generate.
status.idle: Ready for your review. Click Generate when the text and destination are correct.
status.running: Generating… The streaming preview is incomplete.
status.success: Generation finished. Review the summary, then copy it or continue processing.
status.stopped: Stopped. The incomplete preview cannot be copied or continued. Your source text is preserved.
status.settings: AI settings are open. Your source text is preserved; generate again after returning.
readiness.checking: Checking provider and model metadata. Your text is not sent.
readiness.configuration_ready: Configuration checked for text generation. This does not guarantee quota or a successful request.
readiness.selection_required: Choose both a provider and a model. Nothing is selected or sent automatically.
readiness.provider_not_configured: Choose a provider here or configure one in AI settings.
readiness.provider_not_registered: The selected provider is no longer registered. Check AI settings or choose another provider yourself.
readiness.provider_login_required: Sign in to the selected provider in AI settings, then check again.
readiness.desktop_required: This provider requires the desktop app. Open this summary there and check again.
readiness.cli_missing: The provider's command-line tool was not found. Check its installation in AI settings, then check again.
readiness.metadata_unavailable: Provider metadata could not be checked. Check AI settings or check again. If both selections are retained, you can try generating with those exact selections.
readiness.metadata_timeout: The metadata check timed out. Check again or try generating with the selected provider and model.
readiness.model_catalog_unknown: The model list is unverified. Check again or try the selected model; it will not be replaced automatically.
readiness.model_catalog_incomplete: The model list is incomplete. The selected model is retained; check again or try generating with it.
readiness.model_catalog_fallback: Only a fallback model list is available. Availability is unverified; check again or explicitly try the selected model.
readiness.agent_unknown: The selected model could not be confirmed. Choose a listed model or check AI settings and check again.
readiness.capability_unavailable: The selected provider or model does not support text generation. Choose a compatible model.
readiness.input_unavailable: The selected model does not support text input. Choose a compatible model.
readiness.configuration_changed: The check no longer matches your selected provider and model. Check again before generating.
readiness.permission_denied: This plugin needs AI permission. Open Plugin permissions, enable AI access, then check again.
readiness.legacy_host: This host cannot check AI configuration. Update Hiven, then reopen AI Summary.
error.selection: Choose both a provider and a model, then generate again.
error.input: Enter some source text before generating.
error.points: Choose a supported summary length, then generate again.
error.incomplete: The stream ended before completion. The preview cannot be used. Try generating again; your source is preserved.
error.empty: The model returned no summary. Try generating again or choose another model; your source is preserved.
error.binding: The run reported a different provider or model. Its output was rejected. Check AI settings and check again.
error.provider: The selected provider could not finish the summary. Check its details and AI settings, or try again. Your source is preserved.
error.openSettings: Could not open AI settings. Try again.
toast.copyFailed: Copy failed. The completed summary is still here; try again.
toast.continueFailed: Could not return to Launcher. Try again or copy the summary.
